graphName: SheetDB Single Delete Operation Knowledge Graph
description: Chronological control flow, data flow, and dependency associations involved in a single-record deletion operation (remove) within SheetDB ORM.

nodes.label: DynamicRepository.remove(id)
nodes.description: The entry point for deleting a single record by primary key. Coordinates relational constraint enforcement (enforceDeleteConstraints) before executing the physical deletion on TableGateway.

nodes.label: DynamicRepository.enforceDeleteConstraints(id)
nodes.description: Orchestrates database constraint verification and topological mutations. Builds the dynamic hydrated graph, validates it, updates nullified foreign keys, and bulk-deletes cascading child records bottom-up.

nodes.label: StaticGraphBuilder.compile(schema)
nodes.description: Compiles raw JSON database schemas into a static directed graph representing table relationship links (belongsTo, hasMany) and onDelete policies.

nodes.label: StaticGraph
nodes.description: The static graph in memory holding structural table node definitions and relational edge metadata.

nodes.label: DynamicGraphBuilder
nodes.description: Retrieves active records and recursively traverses relationships starting from the root parent record, hydration-binding sheet records to build a dynamic graph.

nodes.label: DynamicGraph
nodes.description: A runtime directed graph containing actual hydrated record nodes (GraphNode) and populated link edges (GraphEdge) representing the live delete cascade boundary.

nodes.label: DeletionValidationRegistry.validate(graph, rootTable, rootId)
nodes.description: Scans the dynamic deletion graph. Triggers validation strategies for all edges originating from records slated to be deleted.

nodes.label: protect validation strategy
nodes.description: Ensures that if active child rows exist, parent deletion is blocked by throwing an IntegrityError (unless the child is also scheduled for deletion).

nodes.label: cascade validation strategy
nodes.description: Verifies that child rows configured for cascade deletes are successfully mapped and present inside the scheduled deletion list.

nodes.label: set_null validation strategy
nodes.description: Checks the child schema: ensures the foreign key (and any associated polymorphic discriminator typeField) allows null values. Throws ValidationError if required is true.

nodes.label: do_nothing validation strategy
nodes.description: Django-style policy; bypasses validation check constraints entirely, allowing parent deletion unconditionally.

nodes.label: ForeignKeyField
nodes.description: Represents relationship key columns. Encapsulates referential integrity assertions during write/save operations by validating key existence in the PrimaryKeyCache.

nodes.label: PrimaryKeyCache
nodes.description: Performance component caching all active primary key values. Synchronized on insert and remove operations to support O(1) referential validation checks.

nodes.label: TableGateway.remove(id)
nodes.description: Performs physical deletion of a single sheet row via SheetDataSource and purges the key from PrimaryKeyCache.

nodes.label: TableGateway.deleteMany(ids)
nodes.description: Performs optimized, bulk spreadsheet row deletion in a single call, synchronizing the PrimaryKeyCache by removing the keys.

nodes.label: TableGateway.updateMany(updatesMap)
nodes.description: Updates multiple record fields in bulk. Used during set_null cascades to nullify foreign key columns.

nodes.label: SheetDataSource
nodes.description: Low-level connection bridge with Google Sheets API. Reads worksheets, performs row insertion/updation, and physically deletes/clears spreadsheet rows.
